L0531

`_ ::` adds no value to this Unit call

What

`_ ::` adds no value to this Unit call

Why

A call with no success value already runs as a statement and propagates a compatible failure

Fix

Remove `_ :: ` and leave the call on its own line

Worked example

First UI snapshot mentioning L0531: tests/ui_lint/redundant_unit_binding.warn.

Warning [L0531] (redundant_unit_binding): `_ ::` adds no value to this Unit call
  --> redundant_unit_binding.jet:16:5
    |
 16 |     _ :: validate(n)
    |     ^
 Why: A call with no success value already runs as a statement and propagates a compatible failure
 Fix: Remove `_ :: ` and leave the call on its own line
